item.title: Wales and Liverpool legend Ian Rush recovering after being in intensive care with flu
item.description: The legendary striker, who grew up in Flint, was admitted to hospital last week

item.title: Joe Wicks has given us permission to have a two day bender over Christmas!!!
item.description: Joe Wicks has given us permission have a two day bender over Christmas!!!

item.title: From strictly to starlight: Venue Cymru’s Cinderella panto is a Christmas cracker
item.description: Strictly Come Dancing AJ Pritchard and his brother and Love Island contestant Curtis Pritchard shone alongside local Britain’s Got Talent finalists Han and Fran in this action-packed adaptation of the classic fairytale Cinderella.

item.title: New hope for future as empty Porth Eirias units freed from retail restrictions
item.description: RESTRICTIONS governing what can be sold at Porth Eirias’ empty retail units were quashed at a Conwy County Council planning committee, widening the building’s potential use.

item.title: Old Colwyn quarry extension approved despite residents' concerns
item.description: Quarry operations in Old Colwyn will be extended after Conwy County Council’s planning committee voted in favour of the scheme – despite residents complaining about noise and pollution.

item.title: Conwy Valley care home that closed earlier this year on the market for £450,000
item.description: The two-storey detached stone property, which was registered for up to 25 service users, comprises 21 single and two double bedrooms.

item.title: Ross Ballantine's family returns to lifeboat station after Nicola Faith tragedy
item.description: Skipper Carl McGrath and crew members Ross and Alan Minard died after setting off from the port of Conwy on the Nicola Faith on January 27, 2021.

item.title: Conwy secondary school 'requires special measures' after Estyn inspection
item.description: A SECONDARY school is set to be placed under special measures following a critical inspection report that highlighted weaknesses in teaching and leadership.

item.title: Unregulated weight-loss medication worth more than £5,000 seized in Conwy Valley
item.description: After concerns raised by members of the public into the unregulated selling of Mounjaro, police executed a search warrant in Llanrwst.

item.title: North Wales woman caught up in Bondi beach shooting ran for her life amid chaos
item.description: Ciara McCann, aged 24, was socialising with friends when the horrifying incident occurred
